name: Little Tree | 200mg Gummies | Cherry
description:
4 Gummies | 50MG Each | Distillate

Our Cherry Distillate Gummies deliver classic fruit flavor and a clean, no-fuss high. With 50MG of precisely dosed THC per gummy, this distillate-infused edible offers reliable effects and long-lasting relaxation.

Featuring a rich, familiar cherry flavor and a consistent texture, this gummy is perfect for unwinding your way—anytime, anywhere.

Whether it’s a night in or a low-key gathering, this gummy brings you back to center.
